Hi {{1}}, {{2}} here from NRI Parent Service. You mentioned you might be looking into travel insurance options for your parents' upcoming visit.

Managing coverage for parents travelling from India can get complicated with pre-existing conditions and emergency medical limits. We built our NRI parent insurance plans to handle exactly these needs, with seamless claims support and zero-hassle paperwork.

Would you have 5 minutes this week for a quick chat, or would you prefer I send over a quick quote breakdown based on their travel dates?

* A complimentary virtual doctor consultation for your parents while they are abroad.
* Complimentary travel companion help, so your parents are not alone on the journey.
